title: Building a Godot Asset Authoring Plugin
body:
I am building a Godot editor plugin that turns imported 3D models into reusable, game-ready interactive assets.

The tool scans the asset catalog, loads a selected GLB/GLTF into an authoring workbench, and lets me fit the model, physics collision box, interaction area, and local orientation axes.

When exported, it saves structured authoring data and generates a clean runtime scene the game can instance anywhere.

The goal is to stop hand-wiring every prop by scene. Once an asset is authored, it carries its visual setup, collision, interaction metadata, and orientation rules with it.
